gloss: year after year; with each passing year

definitions.gloss: year after year; with each passing year
definitions.explanation: A literary or emphatic expression meaning every single year, emphasizing the repetitive nature of change over time. More formal and literary than {年々|ねんねん}.

examples.japanese: {年々歳々|ねんねんさいさい}{花|はな}は{同|おな}じだが、{人|ひと}は{変|か}わる。
examples.english: Year after year the flowers are the same, but people change.
examples.notes: From a famous Chinese poem by Liu Xiyi.

examples.japanese: {年々歳々|ねんねんさいさい}、この{町|まち}の{風景|ふうけい}は{変|か}わっていく。
examples.english: Year after year, the scenery of this town keeps changing.

examples.japanese: {年々歳々|ねんねんさいさい}{技術|ぎじゅつ}が{進歩|しんぽ}して、{生活|せいかつ}は{便利|べんり}になっている。
examples.english: With each passing year, technology advances and life becomes more convenient.

notes:
USAGE:
A literary four-character expression ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}) originating from a Tang Dynasty Chinese poem. More emphatic and literary than the simpler {年々|ねんねん}. Often used in reflective or philosophical contexts about the passage of time.

ETYMOLOGY:
From a poem by Liu Xiyi ({劉希夷|りゅうきい}): 「{年年歳歳|ねんねんさいさい}{花|はな}{相似|あいにたり}、{歳歳年年|さいさいねんねん}{人|ひと}{不同|おなじからず}」— "Year after year the flowers are alike; year after year the people are different."

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {年々|ねんねん}: year by year — the simpler, more common form
- {毎年|まいとし}: every year — a neutral, everyday expression
